temporal_semantics.app_bootstrap: The positive historical order is entry -> InitPlugins -> Init -> Startup -> repeated IAppSystem::Get. The bootstrap state machine at 0x00e20860 was not reached in that 30-second window; its raw states are not inferred from the startup order.
temporal_semantics.app_system: SDK vtable order is a phase vocabulary, not runtime order. The only positive observed order is InitPlugins before Init before Startup. Shutdown, Pause, Unpause, Configure, InitGraphics, and PreShutdown are interface or static-consumer evidence without a complete runtime sequence.
temporal_semantics.cell_mode: IGameMode dispatch exposes Initialize, OnEnter, Update, OnExit, and Dispose. The Cell static bodies show display/service enable on entry, per-frame work, global restoration and service disable on exit, and resource release on Dispose; the app calls appearing inside Initialize/Dispose remain decompiler-sensitive.
temporal_semantics.mode_transition: The strongest original transition order is old OnExit -> write active index -> send mode-exit message -> new OnEnter -> send mode-enter message. The Simulator listener then commits last/current mode IDs through separate pending-state helpers; transition-effect callbacks are related effects but do not directly write those IDs.
temporal_semantics.runtime_evidence: Only the historical main-menu startup capture is positive. No original orderly shutdown, in-game mode switch, menu-to-stage transition, or Cell-mode trace is available in this artifact.
temporal_semantics.subsystem_update: cSimulatorSystem exposes separate Update, PostUpdate, and UpdateUIGraphics phases, but the concrete mSubSystems iteration order, persistence across mode changes, and subsystem enable/disable semantics are unresolved. The shared packed global block is a service seam, not ownership proof.
